metadata.description: Template for frequently asked questions edited by the conversational CMS.

title: Frequently asked
with editorial structure
hero.description: A simple template for product, support, onboarding or legal questions.

items.question: Who can edit this page?
items.answer: Any role authorized by the CMS can propose changes and generate a preview.

items.question: Can I add questions?
items.answer: Yes, as long as the payload keeps matching the FAQ schema.

items.question: Is publish automatic?
items.answer: No. Preview and publish are separate steps by design.
